basic_profile.bio: Lifelong manga enthusiast based in Toronto, Canada. By day, I work as a graphic designer, and by night, I'm a devoted manga reader and anime watcher. I have a keen interest in indie music and sports, particularly soccer, with a soft spot for Fenerbahce. I dislike mecha genres but enjoy stories with hidden powers and unexpected twists. My online hours are typically in the evenings and weekends when I'm not busy with work or catching a local soccer game. I'm in a long-term relationship, and my partner shares my love for anime and pop culture.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in manga and anime has been cultivated over decades of reading and watching various series. This passion began in my early teens and has persisted ever since. I have a background in visual arts, having completed a bachelor's degree in graphic design, which also influences my appreciation for manga artistry.
